safeNote: Only caches and leftovers. Apps rebuild or re-download them when needed; no settings, logins or files are touched.
failed.auth: Not cleaned: password prompt was cancelled
failed.busy: Not cleaned: the app is open
desc.uv: Python packages uv downloaded; fetched again when needed
desc.mise: Tool and runtime downloads; installed tools stay
desc.aur: Leftover yay/paru builds; installed packages stay
desc.vscode: C++ IntelliSense index and old extension downloads
desc.brave: Cached web pages and images; logins and tabs stay
desc.spotify: Streamed songs cache; downloads and login stay
desc.devtools: Debug symbols, test browsers, node-gyp headers
desc.models: Hugging Face models; large to download again
desc.trash: Files you deleted; gone for good after this
desc.pacman: Keeps the newest copy of each for rollback
desc.coredumps: Saved memory of apps that crashed
